name: Empowered Deskari Effigy
disable: DC 20 Arcana check (expert) or DC 20 Religion check (trained) to deactivate the effigy or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 23) to dispel the statuette
reset: 1 minute as the illusory insects harass intruders before scuttling into the earth.

items.name: False Swarm
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the hidden entrance without saying the cultists' password

---
Effect A swarm of illusionary insects bursts out of the grass in a 60-foot cone from the Deskari effigy and seemingly crawl over the intruders, shrieking incessantly. All creatures in the area must make a DC 19 Fortitude save save or become temporarily Deafened for 1 minute (deafened and Clumsy 1 for 1 minute on a critical failure).

text: A statuette of the deceased demon lord creates frightening illusions of insect swarms.
